def module_accepts(name, values, modules, pipes_by_target):
    module = modules[name]
    if module.requires is not None and not module.requires(values): return False
    for target, filt, bind in pipes_by_target.get(name, ()):
        fvals = {fp: values[tp] for fp, tp in bind.items()}
        if not module_accepts(filt, fvals, ...): return False
